verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a Funnels report that measures conversion through a series of events. Its marketing claims it surfaces critical drop-off points, and its reports are interactive and run 'with just a few clicks'. Session Replay and natural-language MCP queries over funnels let a non-analyst find and explain drop-offs, and community comments note PMs building custom reports quickly. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on per-step drop-off breakdowns (the funnel evidence is a one-line description), and independent hands-on corroboration of funnel drop-off analysis by non-analysts (community praise is mostly about Flows, with some usability complaints).

support.subject: As a founder, I can answer "which activation step loses users?" myself with funnels and drop-off analysis, without an analyst

citations.quote: Measure conversions through a series of events
Discover critical drop-off points and calibrate user journeys
analyze this data with interactive reports that let you query and visualize the results with just a few clicks
you can quickly follow up by exploring why customers drop off
you can query events, funnels, flows, retention, session replays, and more using natural language
I've seen PMs spend hours in mixpanel quickly generating custom report after custom report.
